title: Naason
summary: Raleigh names Naason in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Naason, also printed Naashon, leader of Iudah. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. II, sig. 199b
